startup_section: 7, Figure 4 and timing table; crossings use 90% of nominal voltage
input_order: Figure 4 shows 5V or VBUS before VCCH. This harness selects main ATX 5V as that source. The timing table does not give an explicit minimum for t5V2VCCH.

engineering_goals.reset_release_after_valid_rails: All three bridge rails are in their operating ranges at the earliest possible reset release, then remain valid until reset reaches its guaranteed-high voltage. This is a conservative project goal, not an explicit tRST requirement in the ASMedia table.
engineering_goals.reset_during_rail_fault: After initial operation, reset reaches its guaranteed-low voltage within 1 ms of a bridge rail leaving its operating range. The 1 ms allowance is a review target, not an ASMedia specification.
